notes.title: Fix for Custom Cats wearing Hats
notes.notes: The last update introduced a bug where hats were to small on custom created cats. It's difficult enough to get a cat to wear a hat, let alone one that doesn't fit. Enough cats complained so we fixed it. I hope you all have a great holiday season!

notes.title: Fix for Japanese Language Support
notes.notes: Fixed issue with Japanese Language support not appearing when selected in settings menu.

notes.title: Cuter Kitties and Carnival Chaos
notes.notes: Hello lovers of cats and chaos!  It's the Halloween update for Cat Saves Halloween.  Our cats have had an overhaul to be cuter than ever.  Now create your cutest cat in our Cat Creator and go enjoy our new Carnival!  Yes a new carnival has come to Cat Saves Halloween.  Enjoy the new games and rides and see and participate in the show!  It is also on sale for 25% off for the Steam Scream Fest. We hope you enjoy our update and have a safe and happy Halloween!

notes.title: Cat Saves Halloween now has the cat creator
notes.notes:
You can now create your own cat with the cat creator. Just click on the cat icon that says Create on the main menu and have fun making your own cat. We also updated the harmony points so you don't have to play multiplayer to get them. All you have to do is finish the main quest line or any good deed quests  to get harmony points. You can also get a few extra chaos points if you do any quests that cause any kind of trouble. Scream Fest ends on Nov. 2nd. You don't want to miss the 20% off sale for this game. Hope you enjoy! Happy Halloween!

notes.title: Storey Halloween arrives just in time for Scream Fest
notes.notes:
We added  Storey Halloween. You now get chaos and harmony points in Cat Saves Halloween. You can use your chaos points to buy hats from the Mad Catter in Storey Halloween. All you have to do is knock down things and cause trouble to earn chaos points. You can also get harmony points by playing multiplayer and sticking with your friends to complete quests. You can buy hats from Harmony in Storey Halloween. There are some masks that Harmony will sell you if you have a certain amount of candy.  Remember to collect candy it's very important to these cats.  This game is 20% off during Scream Fest. We hope you enjoy! 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38912051/278e2f600947388c1812e271545fbefacd8b0414.png[/img]

notes.title: Climbing Improvements and Quest Fixes
notes.notes:
In this patch Climbing and Climbing animations have been greatly improved.  Climbing speed has been increased and the cat will auto center when climbing things like poles and other difficult items.  New side to side and vertical animations added for climbing as well.

Also some quest bugs have been addressed.
- Fixed issue where final portal would sometimes not spawn
- Fixed issue where Dr. Purrkins quest would not complete
- Quest Mobs can be respawned on unfinished quests

notes.title: Improvements to Jump Animations and Mob Respawning
notes.notes: Whew,  now that Halloween is over we are working on improving some of the animations and gameplay features so the game is overall smoother and even more entertaining.  We'll be releasing some more updates to the cat animations and gameplay in the near future.  Just 362 more days till Halloween!

notes.title: Unlock the Ghost Cat
notes.notes:
Unlock the ghost cat named Catspurr and add to your selection of cat characters to play in the game. To unlock this ghostly cat you must first complete a task for Catspurr.  Words of Advice: make sure you have completed the mystery mansion before trying to unlock this friendly ghost cat.

We also updated the Scarecrow quest on the farm that will have you driving like mad so the plants don't take over.

notes.title: Mystery Mansion Update
notes.notes:
The Mystery Mansion update extends the main story of Cat Saves Halloween.  Through the story our brave cats visit Mystery Mansion twice,  and things are frighteningly different.  Will our cat hero be brave enough to explore the Mansion and uncover its mysteries before it's too late?

This update adds several new quests and features along with a new ridable vehicles and more surprises!

Features include:

[list]
[*] 2 New Maps,  (Mystery Mansion - Before and After)
[*] New NPCs and Quests
[*] A New Dungeon to Explore
[*] New Baddies and bosses
[*] Fun Tombstone Labels
[*] New Ridable Vehicles
[*] Vehicles now have Radio Station Support
[/list]

notes.title: Performance improvement and improved Lan play
notes.notes: We upgraded to unreal 5 which has improved the performance of the game. We also improved Lan play, added reticle (crosshairs)  for targeting, and you now can unequip your hats or weapons.

notes.title: Halloween Goodies! - New Bosses, Race Tracks and more!
notes.notes:
Happy Halloween everyone!  Here's a cat treat for ya! In this release we...

Added new bosses to the Level 3 & 4 Graves
Added a Tractor Race Track on the Farm Map
Improved Vehicle Physics for Multiplayer
Improved Tutorials

Have Fun!

notes.title: Save Halloween for 20% off during the Steam Halloween Sale 2021
notes.notes:
Earlier this fall we have added quests, the flipside that is spooky, and more mischief such as driving vehicles. There are so many surprises in our game from spooky to just silly. Our game will be 20% during the Steam Halloween Sale 2021.

notes.title: Cat Saves Halloween - With a Vengeance
notes.notes:
We are excited to share this update with you, can you tell?  Whether you think our humor is clawful or purrfectly pawesome, you'll have to admit there's a lot of new hilarity and hijinks in this fur-filled adventure.  As a cat, help Professor McGonaclaw and Meowpheus save the world from the clutches of the evil Rat-King and his minions.  Will you save Halloween or take part in the chaos?  Well, my furry friend... the choice is yours! 

This update adds the following:
[list]
[*] New main story with tons of new characters to meet
[*] New maps to explore like the FlipSide (enter if you dare)
[*] Overhaul of the dungeons
[*] New Dungeon Bosses
[*] More side-quests and things to explore
[*] New interactable items
[*] Final Boss Battle and new game ending 
[/list]

Oh,, you're still here?  Erm.. Congratulations!  You've made it to the end of this post.  Now,  go play 
[b]Cat Saves Halloween[/b]!!

And Thanks!!!

notes.title: Cat Saves Halloween - First Update!
notes.notes:
Tiger and Winter are getting a make-over!  Midnight, Angel, Stormy and Blaze are all short-hair cats, but their friends Tiger and Winter now have their full winter coats.  These two characters are now long-hair cats and look great!   

Along with the new models,  each Cat can collect new wearable items to go along with their powers.  Items like the Witch's Hat can restore your mana, while the Runner's Cap can increase your overall speed.  You can only wear one item at a time but can switch anytime you choose in your inventory.  Each item comes in 5 pieces,  collect the pieces on the maps to assemble your new item. Each surface map has it's own wearable item to collect.

A new dungeon has been added to the Farm map that also contains brand new enemies and items, but we won't spoil that for you.
